description:
Position: Application Developer 
 Location: Florham Park, NJ 
 Duration: 3+ Month Contract to Hire 
 The Application Developer we are looking for will need to have the skill set to cover both modes of IT landscape.As such, he/she builds a complete view of IT capabilities and assets, both current and future needs in a way which ensures alignment with the overall strategy and business model. Furthermore he/she ensures clear guidance and direction for IT developments which support business needs in an effective and cost efficient manner. 
 Key Responsibilities 

 • Develops enterprise level application and custom integration solutions including major enhancements and interfaces, functions and features
• Provides expertise regarding the integration of applications across the business and design recommendations based on long term IT organization strategy
• Determines specifications, then plans, designs and develops the most complex and business critical software solutions
• Has responsibility for availability and performance of applications, in particular driving incident and problem to cost effective solutions
• Has responsibility for ensuring that the system lifecycle is followed and all IT governance processes and procedures are adhered to
• Partners with other Application Managers and Service Managers, SLA Vendors to resolve incidents and problems across system landscape
• Execute agile /scrum methods to improve, efficiencies, better bottom line results, quick wins and higher quality deliverables, participating in daily stand-up meetings when appropriate
• Has in-depth knowledge and experience within own job discipline. Handles most situations independently and escalates when necessary.
• Align Regional with Global IT for the IT strategy and key projects and programs
• Support regional PMO and SCRUM Master(s) in design, estimating and planning solutions and Bimodal EA approach
• Ability to travel internationally, if required


 Who we are looking for
• High School Diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Information Systems Technology preferred.
• 5 years minimum of multi-tier application design and development required
• Result -oriented, detail-oriented, team work, Self-driven with sense of urgency
• Communicating solution architecture strategy to individuals of diverse backgrounds
• Logistics / transportation knowledge
• Strong analytical sense and ability to master complex logic, attention to detail
• Strong Programming skills with expertise in web applications, MSFT.NET, Visual Basic, SQL, JAVA, AJAX, Crystal Reports.
• ITIL Foundation Certified, MTA&MCSD Certified, SCRUM Developer Certified or equivalent
• App Architecture and user experience design UX/UI, Microsoft Azure
• Application Programming Interface (API) experience
• Successful Project examples & references to support the above

 
 
 


 Syed Mohammad Asif 
 408-775-7468
